reviews.comment: This has been my favorite class of college so far. Professor Skillen is an amazing professor and genuinely cares about the success and wellbeing of his students. If you want to do structural, I recommend taking him for steel as he taught us concepts on real project plans, took us on a structural tour of Kyle Field, and brought in guest speakers.
If you're interested in structural engineering, you'll need to take Skillen. He will help you learn how the profession actually works.

Perhaps the worst professor I have ever had. Left feedback to come to his office for help, only to be told "I cant help you". This continued for the whole semester. Also, class was a disaster and did not follow his own syllabus (We skipped around on topics). 

Beware for graduate level courses.

Dr. Skillen is one of the best professors to have for theory of structures. He focuses on real world application. Exams can be difficult but are definitely fair. He tries his best to help students and teaches concept in a way that is easy to learn. He posts lecture notes and previous example which make learning way easier. Not a lot of homework.

Skillen was a cool prof and wants you to ask questions. He cares about his students and is passionate about what he teaches. His lectures/homework were over stuff in the real world. No "mickey mouse" problems in this class, which made this course very interesting. The homework could be challenging but he was easily available outside of class.

Overall CVEN 345 is a really hard class. Kinsey is a really passionate prof who really wants you to learn, sometimes he's way to smart for his own good and can be hard to keep up, but he's really helpful and kind. His class is only homework and quizzes and he generally sets us up pretty well to succeed. Overall prob the best prof for 345.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a really passionate and smart prof. He's always available in his office and ready to help. The material itself can be hard, but he will make sure that we understand. Its pretty easy to pass if you just ask him for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Skillen is the best prof I've had at A&M so far. He really wants to ensure that you understand the material. If you understand it, your grade will reflect that. Go to his office hours; He is available all the time to explain concepts and work problems. He makes a naturally difficult class easy to understand. Quizzes and HW only.
